answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 31134 Country: Pakistan Title: I would like to know is islam gave the permission to have nikkah with a girl with whom u have sexual relationship before? Question: I would like to know is islam gave the permission to have nikkah with a girl with whom u have sexual relationship before? Answer ID: 31134 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 498/417/B=1432) Yes, it is allowed rather the nikah of an adulterer with an adulteress is better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
